summary: Iteration 41 — backend pytest 10/10 PASS and frontend Playwright on all 4 new surfaces is GREEN. /api/social/best-times returns one row per platform with the exact shape requested (platform, platformLabel, recommendedHour int, recommendedTime HH:MM, sampleSize int, source ∈ {pos_peak | pos_peak_clamped | default_band}, band [lo,hi]) — anon-401 honored. /api/social/ai-weekly-plan?useBestTimes=true&save=false returns preview with bestTimeMap populated and every post's scheduledFor.hour == best-times[platform]; useBestTimes=false produces all posts at the fixed postTime (12:00). The save=true path returns {status:'queued', planId, bestTimeMap, expected, platformsUsed, message} immediately; polling /api/social/plan-jobs/{planId} reaches status=complete and the resulting social_posts have per-platform hours matching best-times. /api/bookings/inbox sets x-ai-parsed-fallback ('true'|'false') on the response header and the body carries aiParsedFallback; CORS Access-Control-Expose-Headers includes x-ai-parsed-fallback. Frontend /social-media → Calendar shows the BEST TIME TO POST chip strip (data-testid=best-times-strip + best-time-{platform}) with all 5 chips (instagram 10:00 Default, facebook 16:00 Default, tiktok 20:00 Default, x 09:00 Default, google_business 12:00 Default) and the 'Use best times in AI plan & drag-drop' checkbox (data-testid=use-best-times-checkbox, default ON). /bookings-inbox renders capture form + cards with parsed AI fields and the AI fallback badge is correctly suppressed when aiParsedFallback=false (verified at backend layer — header agreed with body). /disputes renders the full Chargeback/Dispute Console with all 5 KPIs (kpi-open=3, kpi-evidence=0, kpi-won=0, kpi-atrisk=$128, kpi-recovered=$0), filter pills (All/Open/Evidence/Won/Lost), status badges, Attach evidence buttons, New Dispute dialog opens (new-dispute-dialog). /app/For Sam.md exists (12.5 KB).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby — a11y warning only, not blocking. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for screen-reader users.

critical_code_review_comments: social_media.py:402-474 — _compute_best_times is well-factored and reusable from both the GET endpoint and the weekly-plan save path. Band clamping (pos_peak vs pos_peak_clamped vs default_band) is correctly attributed in `source`. POS aggregation pipeline uses $dateFromString → $hour which is correct for ISO timestamps; sample_size aggregates across all matching categories, not just the chosen hour — a fair signal of overall demand.
social_media.py:477-487 — WeeklyPlanIn.useBestTimes default False keeps API backwards-compatible. Comment block explains the trade-off.

social_media.py:656-662 / 743-747 — _resolve_scheduled_for + _sched_for are duplicated logic between the inline preview and the background worker. Minor DRY violation — could factor into one helper. Functionality is identical; risk is future divergence.
bookings_inbox.py:55-83 — Response.headers['x-ai-parsed-fallback'] set BEFORE Mongo insert; body persists aiParsedFallback flag so historic cards can still be flagged. Robust.
server.py:140-148 — CORS expose_headers=['x-ai-parsed-fallback'] correctly configured; verified via real CORS response (case-insensitive match passed).
Disputes.jsx — Radix Dialog missing DialogDescription (a11y warning in console). Cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, Social Calendar chip strip + checkbox, Bookings Inbox capture form + cards, Disputes console + KPIs + dialog open)

seed_data_creation: Ensured 5 connected social accounts (one per platform) via auto-fixture in test_iteration41_best_times_and_inbox.py (handles nuva_iter41_{platform}). Inserted ~3 TEST_iter41 bookings-inbox cards and 1 weekly-plan run worth of scheduled social_posts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 41 is GREEN end-to-end. The only outstanding cosmetic item is a Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription on /disputes (a11y warning, not blocking). The carry-over BAS field-naming nit from iter 40 is still open. Notes for future testing: (1) The /api/social/ai-weekly-plan save-path test polls /api/social/plan-jobs/{id} but the background worker hits the LLM heavily; use a 45s per-poll read-timeout (not 15s) to avoid spurious test failures. (2) /bookings-inbox 'Capture Inbound' opens an INLINE form (not a Radix dialog), so testers should locate the textarea via 'textarea' rather than '[role="dialog"] textarea'. (3) AI fallback badges (data-testid=ai-fallback-{id}) only render when aiParsedFallback=true; in normal LLM-up conditions you won't see them — to force-test the UI badge, temporarily unset EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and ingest a message. (4) The new useBestTimes plumbing is end-to-end: preview, save, and background worker all honour best_time_map and fall back cleanly to fixed postTime when the map is empty.
